questions.scenario: Your school is organizing a big annual drama. What is your dream role?

options.text: Directing the actors and setting up the stage lighting.
Interviewing the cast and writing a report for the school magazine.
Writing the dialogues and the emotional storyline.
Shooting a funny 'behind-the-scenes' vlog for social media.

questions.scenario: How do you usually use Instagram or YouTube?

options.text: Watching beautifully shot cinematic videos and short films.
Following news, current affairs, and real-life documentaries.
Reading deep quotes, long captions, or Twitter threads.
Tracking viral trends, memes, and watching daily vloggers.

questions.scenario: You are sitting at a very busy railway station. What are you observing?

options.text: The lighting, shadows, and how cool the scene would look on camera.
Listening to people's conversations to know what's happening in their lives.
Imagining a fictional backstory for a random stranger sitting far away.
Thinking about a cool prank, challenge, or reel that can be shot here.

questions.scenario: If you had a magic tool, what would it be?

options.text: A camera that can capture exactly what I imagine in my brain.
A mic that makes people tell only the absolute truth.
A pen that writes stories so powerful, it makes people cry.
A phone where every single post instantly goes viral globally.

questions.scenario: There is a massive rumor spreading in your class. What do you do?

options.text: Think about turning this dramatic situation into a movie plot.
Investigate, ask questions, and find out the actual truth.
Write a sarcastic or funny poem/story about how silly the rumor is.
Start a live group chat or podcast to discuss it with everyone.

questions.scenario: You went on a beautiful family trip. How do you document your memories?

options.text: Edit a slow-motion montage video with aesthetic music.
Write a factual blog about the history and culture of the place.
Write a poetic journal entry about how the place made me feel.
Hold the camera, talk to it daily, and make a fun travel vlog.

questions.scenario: Every creative job has a 'frustrating' part. What can you tolerate happily?

options.text: Sitting in a dark room editing the same video for 8 hours.
Standing outside in the hot sun for hours waiting for one interview.
Deleting and rewriting the same paragraph 20 times until it's perfect.
Reading hundreds of negative or hate comments and ignoring them.

questions.scenario: What is your favorite weapon of choice?

options.text: A professional DSLR camera and lenses.
A notepad and an audio recorder.
A keyboard or a fancy fountain pen.
A ring light, a smartphone, and an energetic voice.

questions.scenario: Someone tells you a very funny joke. What is your brain's reaction?

options.text: I imagine how funny it would look if it was acted out in a scene.
I ask them, 'Wait, is this a true story? Who did this happen to?'
I try to change the punchline in my head to make it even funnier.
I immediately open my camera and narrate the joke to my followers.

questions.scenario: In the world of media, which title suits you best?

options.text: The Visionary (Director).
The Truth Seeker (Reporter).
The Wordsmith (Writer).
The Entertainer (Influencer/Host).
